guidance: Tomatoes generally grow well in slightly acidic soil. The suitable pH range depends on the production system, soil conditions, and local agricultural recommendations.
safety_note: Do not recommend lime or sulfur application based only on pH. Confirm the soil test, local recommendations, and amendment requirements first.

guidance: Tomato plants require adequate soil moisture, but both water stress and excessive moisture can negatively affect plant health.
safety_note: Interpret moisture sensor readings using sensor calibration, soil type, root-zone depth, and crop growth stage.

guidance: Temperature affects tomato growth, flowering, fruit set, and development. Recommendations should account for the crop growth stage and local growing conditions.
safety_note: Do not prescribe a specific heat-management action without checking crop stage and verified local guidance.
